root_quaternion_convention: MuJoCo root freejoint qpos[3:7] is unit w,x,y,z mapping regular BODY axes into world; fixture uses its exact saved quaternion. Extract initial pitch atan2(-R20,hypot(R00,R10)), cross-check saved final_rpy without inventing a new acceptance gate. Public poses use [cos(p/2),0,sin(p/2),0], roll=yaw=0 and authored qpos0 rootXYZ before seating.
